children: CMS Info Systems, a leading business services platform serving BFSI and retail sectors, has reported that its net profit was up 10 per cent in the September quarter to ₹81 crore, on the back of buoyant demand across sectors.
Revenue increased 7 per cent to ₹650 crore. EBITDA was up 25 per cent to ₹173 crore.
Revenue from cash logistics increased 2 per cent to ₹404 crore while managed services and technology solutions division revenue was up 19 per cent to ₹321 crore.
Rajiv Kaul, Executive Vice Chairman & CEO, CMS Info Systems, said this is the fourth straight quarter of record services revenue and the business mix is shifting.
Four years ago, he said technology and payment solutions did ₹120 crore of revenue in a full year. In Q2, it achieved ₹127 crore in revenue.

“We won two large bank mandates in branch surveillance and ATM software, which will deliver revenue growth and returns on our investments in the HAWKAI platform. With the order book in place and deliveries scheduled on orders already won, most of our H2 revenue is contracted,” he added.

India’s banking services and retail platforms rely heavily on managed logistics and vision AI monitoring. CMS Info Systems holds key market shares across ATM software, managed services and currency transit networks, benefiting from expanding bank branch networks and automated retail touchpoints.

title: CMS Info Systems Q2 net profit climbs 10% to ₹81 crore on better demand
